datasets.name: GeoEye-1 image data (spatial resolution: 0.5 m) of Tuergen Township, Xinyuan County
datasets.verbatim: The remote sensing images of Tuergen Township used are GeoEye-1 image data (spatial resolution: 0.5 m) from Google Earth

datasets.name: Landslide and other topographic images of Xinyuan County

methods.name: Dual Graph Convolutional Network (DGCNet)
methods.summary: A deep learning model that uses dual graph convolution layers to capture both local and global structural information by modeling spatial relationships between pixels and interdependencies along channel dimensions.
methods.verbatim: The Dual Graph Convolutional Network (DGCNet) is characterized by its ability to operate on graph-structured data... Zhang et al. (2019) used the model for semantic segmentation and achieved good results.

availability.author_statement: "The original contributions presented in the study are included in the article/Supplementary Material, further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding author."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the GeoEye-1 imagery is a commercial dataset without a provided link. The custom DGCNet code is mentioned but lacks a repository or persistent link.
